title: oenothera campestris var. obispoensis
intro: Oenothera campestris var. obispoensis, commonly known as Evening Primrose, is a flowering plant native to the western coast of North America. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving symptoms of menopause and premenstrual syndrome due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Evening Primrose include anti-inflammatory and hormone-regulating properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as gamma-linolenic acid (GLA) and other polyunsaturated fatty acids. The bioactive constituents of Oenothera campestris var. obispoensis, including GLA and other fatty acids, contribute to its therapeutic effects.
